name: M5-guarantees-unchecked
why: an installer that only copies bytes would satisfy a contract that names transaction, provenance and recovery

name: E1-external-owner-unnamed
old:
owner="the frontier-model pricing market (per-token list prices "
              "published by the model vendors)",

name: E2-authority-disclaimer-dropped
why: without it, lifecycle=active on an externally-owned capability reads as 'the external thing works'

name: E3-classify-without-an-owner
old:
elif status == R.EXTERNAL and R.external_owner(c.id):
            owner = R.external_owner(c.id)
new:
elif status == R.EXTERNAL:
            owner = R.external_owner(c.id) or "unknown"

why: every repository on the machine becomes the Power Pack. NOTE: this edit is byte-length preserving, which is exactly the shape that leaves a stale .pyc valid when the restore lands in the same second -- the reason this plan must be driven by mutation_probe rather than by hand

name: I3-worktree-resolver-bypassed
why: a linked worktree stops resolving to the repository it belongs to
